title: A Remarkable Scavenger Hunt: Exploring Forest City
includes: Digital Copies of your scavenger hunt photos
All taxes, fees and handling charges
Photo challenges for each player - choose between Braniac, Photographer, Mapper
Let's Roam App access for maps, photo challenges, riddles and leaderboards
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Weather Check: Check the weather forecast for the day of your hunt and dress appropriately. Comfortable shoes and weather appropriate attire are recommended
Please note that this is a self-guided private tour so you can start at any time and at your own pace
Fully Charged Devices: Make sure your smartphone is fully charged before the tour as you’ll be using it to navigate and interact with the app. Please bring a power bank if you need it.
Booking Confirmation: Confirmation will be received at time of booking along with instructions on downloading the app and starting your adventure
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Get ready to unleash your inner adventurer with Let’s Roam, the top-rated app-led scavenger hunt company! Wander through city streets and uncover hidden gems while tackling trivia questions and thrilling challenges. Whether you’re collaborating with your crew or engaging in friendly competition, Let’s Roam guarantees a blast filled with laughter and discovery.

Perfect for any occasion – whether it’s a spontaneous day out, a wild bachelorette bash, a birthday blowout, or a team-building extravaganza – Let’s Roam transforms every outing into an unforgettable adventure. 

Each player gets to choose their interactive role, ensuring a personalized experience packed with surprises and fun. Ready to embark on a journey of epic proportions? Let’s Roam is your ultimate guide to making memories that’ll last a lifetime!
